subject: general
question:
Select the option that corrects the misspelt words in the given sentence.

I can't pitcure him figting or picking on anyone.

options.text: I can't picture him fighting or picking on anyone.
I can't pitcure him fiting or piking on anyone.
I can't pitcure him fighting or pekking on anyone.
I can't pictre him fighting or pickning on anyone.

solution:
The correct answer is **I can't picture him fighting or picking on anyone.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The only word which is spelled incorrectly in the given sentence is: Fighting
 
• The word Fighting means 'an occasion when people fight (**लड़ाई-झगड़ा**)'.
 
 
• Example:* There has been street **fighting** in many parts of the city today.*
 
• **Synonyms: **battle, clash, combat, etc.
 
• **Antonyms: **concord, harmony, agreement, etc.
 
 
 
• ​Therefore, the correct sentence would be:* I can't picture him fighting or picking on anyone.*

 

Hence, option 1 is the correct choice.
